programme.desc: S6 E8 — Desculpa para Matar Uma cidade de Nova Hampshire se abala quando quatro adolescentes assassinam uma mulher e mutilam a filha dela, de 11 anos. Os investigadores descobrem dois suspeitos que não são criminosos comuns, mas psicopatas sádicos.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Morte na Estrada Em um incidente em uma estrada, um idoso é espancado até a morte por um adolescente que alega legítima defesa. Durante a investigação, a polícia descobre que ele é um psicopata frio e manipulador.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Bosque das Sombras A fazenda da família era o playground dos irmãos Harpe, até virar o local do assassinato de seus pais. Depois, os irmãos aprenderam a matar e viraram os primeiros serial killers dos Estados Unidos.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S3 E6 — Herança Macabra Uma família perfeita adotou Jeff Landrigan, mas ninguém poderia imaginar o poder dos genes. Mesmo sem conhecer seu pai biológico, Jeff seguiu o mesmo caminho de morte e destruição traçado por ele.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S14 E4 — Homicídio no Mar O jovem Vince Boston se torna cúmplice involuntário de um crime terrível. Ele descobre que seu pai, Silas Boston, é um assassino. Vince tenta obter justiça para as muitas vítimas de seu pai.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S14 E2 — Presa na Casa de Torturas A lealdade de Tammy Moore à sua mãe, Marie, é incondicional. Mesmo com a polícia prendendo Marie por homicídio, Tammy chega a mentir para protegê-la, mas começa a reconhecer os atos terríveis cometidos por ela.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S3 E5 — Um Passo em Falso Em 2005, em uma pequena cidade da Flórida, uma mulher consegue impedir o assassinato de seu neto. Durante a investigação, a polícia descobre que as testemunhas sabem mais do que revelam.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S3 E6 — O Fim da Inocência Em 1986, Geri Muck procura a filha desaparecida, sem saber que é tarde demais. O promotor quer justiça, o irmão busca vingança, mas Geri quer apenas que sua filha volte para casa.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Flertando com a Morte Norma Rodriguez encontrou seu príncipe encantado, mas é ameaçada pelo ex-marido. O segredo mortal de seu melhor amigo e o passado obscuro de um colega culminam em seu brutal assassinato.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Família Fatal Ruie Ann Park é rica e conhecida por sua língua afiada. Ela governa a cidade com vigor, até o estilo de vida polêmico de seu filho e a ambição por seu dinheiro levarem Ruie para um final amargo.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Rainha da Mentira Um amado policial é encontrado morto. O que primeiro parece ser o suicídio se transforma em uma investigação de assassinato e os detetives descobrem uma história de amor, luxúria e vingança.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S2 E9 — Rastros de Ódio Quando Cynthia Roth morre afogada em um lago, a polícia precisa empreender esforços extraordinários para evitar que seu assassino ataque novamente; a investigação revela uma onda de crimes que dura décadas.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Serial Killers à Solta Bombeiros encontram dois corpos empalados com espadas em uma casa incendiada na Rua Elm. A polícia não consegue identificar a vítima do sexo feminino e precisa capturar o assassino antes que ele ataque de novo.
programme.title: Assassinatos na Rua Elm

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Um Assassino nas Paredes Um homem descobre que a esposa e seus dois filhos foram brutalmente assassinados. A polícia desconfia de um suspeito já conhecido. Há um ano, um adolescente perturbado aterrorizou uma família durante meses.
programme.title: The Real Murders on Elm Street

programme.desc: S1 E3 — A Roda do Castigo Investigadores respondem a chamado sobre um ataque a um homem em frente a uma casa na Elm Street e descobrem um sangrento homicídio quádruplo. Os detetives logo descobrem que há mais nesses assassinatos do que aparenta.
programme.title: Assassinatos na Rua Elm

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Luzes Apagadas Um casal de idosos é atacado brutalmente em casa e a cena do crime aponta para violência sexual. Os investigadores miram uma aliança desaparecida, que pode ser a chave para encontrar o criminoso diabólico.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Mistério em Ohio O ex-prefeito de Potowan Point, Ohio, aparece morto em seu chalé de caça. O investigador Ryan Allar e sua equipe tentam descobrir se foi uma retaliação política ou um crime com motivações pessoais.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Assassinato no Capitólio Uma jovem mãe desaparece em um bairro violento de Washington, capital dos Estados Unidos, e a investigadora Jackie Middleton precisa desvendar uma conspiração impiedosa.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Ocorrências Familiares O COPOM lida com supostos sequestros, além de uma ocorrência com reféns.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Câmeras Corporais Policiais Três chamados em diferentes pontos da cidade mexem com a rotina do Copom.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Não Mexam com Meus Filhos Dois ladrões armados tentam roubar um carro, mas tomam um susto quando a dona reage; o pai de uma garota de 15 anos prepara uma armadilha para pegar o homem de 33 anos que está tentando seduzi-la.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Corram Ladrões roubam um tubarão e são perseguidos pelos funcionários do aquário; dois presidiários conseguem fugir escondidos em latas de lixo. Eles estão à solta e a caçada para encontrá-los já começou.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Para Retirada Um ladrão armado tenta roubar quatro rapazes, mas toma um susto quando eles reagem. Um homem invade uma oficina com uma metralhadora, mas é dominado por um mecânico que não se rende.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Movimentos Ousados Um tiroteio começa quando mãe e filha defendem seu negócio de um ladrão armado. Um homem que tenta roubar um instrutor de artes marciais logo percebe que mexeu com a pessoa errada.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S19 E4 — 100% Certeza que Ele É um Monstro As pessoas relatam suas histórias reais e aterrorizantes sobre conviver com amigos ou familiares sociopatas que posteriormente cometeram crimes hediondos.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S19 E5 — Todos Viram Sua Maldade Uma mulher recém-divorciada conhece um pai gentil, atencioso e carinhoso. Apesar de suas reservas em relação a um novo relacionamento, ela se apaixona. No entanto, ela não percebe o que todos ao seu redor veem: que ele é um assassino.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S5 E4 — Hotel da Morte Um estranho misterioso estrangula a recepcionista Mary Klatt durante seu turno, no meio da noite. A cidade de Blue Earth, em Minnesota, se choca ao pensar que alguém quis fazer mal a Mary.
programme.title: Cidade Pacata, Crime Cruel

programme.desc: S5 E6 — Homicídio em Mount Pleasant A colega de quarto de Liz Syperda, de 22 anos, comunica seu desaparecimento e choca a cidade de Mount Pleasant, no Iowa. Alguns acham que Liz deixou a cidade sem avisar, mas sua família sabe que algo sinistro aconteceu.
programme.title: Cidade Pacata, Crime Cruel

programme.desc: S10 E2 — Não Quero Ser Preso As autoridades ficam preocupadas quando uma mulher de 25 anos relata o desaparecimento do pai de 50 anos e da filha de seis anos. A polícia encontra os corpos e revela a verdade chocante: ela é uma assassina psicótica.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S10 E3 — A Raiva Voltou Por mais de três décadas, a polícia de Albuquerque luta para solucionar três casos violentos arquivados. Após anos de buscas, os casos se revelam quando os policiais prendem um homem que violou sua liberdade condicional.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Homicídio no Monte Baldy Uma tragédia abala uma comunidade nas montanhas quando Jack Irwin, de 71 anos, desaparece sem deixar vestígios. Crimes estranhos assombram a velha cabana onde Jack morava, e uma escuta telefônica expõe uma confissão chocante.
programme.title: Crimes na Cabana

programme.desc: S3 E10 — Companheiro das Sombras Sandi Musk acredita que Andy LeFleur a ajudará a esquecer o processo de divórcio. Quando percebe que ele quer um compromisso sério, Sandi descobre que Andy não aceita um não como resposta.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Mentiras em Família Um crime impensável destrói os sonhos de um homem por uma vida melhor no estado da Flórida. Para encontrar o culpado, os investigadores precisam desvendar uma série de mentiras antes que o assassino ataque novamente.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S6 E8 — A Mágoa Em janeiro de 2020, uma menonita desaparece de uma comunidade religiosa. Quando o corpo é encontrado, as provas materiais não são conclusivas e os investigadores precisam usar a criatividade para encontrar o assassino.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Ganhem pelo Dom Juan Como quarterback e, depois, como treinador, Juan Joseph levou seu time de futebol americano a várias vitórias. Ao ser assassinado inexplicavelmente, a comunidade se une para levar o criminoso à justiça.

programme.desc: S9 E9 — Explosão Perigosa Em Ohio, policiais e bombeiros correm para se salvar depois de uma explosão de gás em um prédio. Um ladrão arranca uma mulher de um carro e foge com os filhos dela. Em Wisconsin, ocorre o roubo inusitado de um limpa-neve.
programme.title: Bodycam - Registros Criminosos

programme.desc: S3 E7 — Alta Velocidade Ciclistas enfrentam motoristas irritados. Dois homens brigam em um cruzamento. Um homem grava um momento tenso em um estacionamento em Nova Jersey. Um motorista persegue um homem que o cortou no trânsito.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Descontrole no Asfalto Um homem agressivo ataca um casal; motoristas se defendem de rapazes que fazem manobras bruscas; uma família se defende de um homem armado com uma faca; duas mulheres discutem no estacionamento de um hospital.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Oxford, Alabama Policiais infiltrados investigam suspeitos de tráfico de drogas. As autoridades planejam a captura de um traficante de fentanila e a de um suspeito que teria ligações com grandes fornecedores de metanfetamina.
programme.title: Operação Infiltrados

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Temporada 2 Episódio 2 Em novembro de 1971, uma mansão de Nova Jersey foi cenário de uma série de terríveis assassinatos. John List matou metodicamente a esposa, a mãe e os três filhos adolescentes. Depois disso, John passou 18 anos desaparecido.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Desaparecimento Uma mãe de três filhos desaparece, e toda a cidade de Renovo, na Pensilvânia, procura por ela. Dois bilhetes de resgate estranhos e uma perseguição levam a polícia a um suspeito que estava debaixo de seu nariz o tempo todo.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S6 E9 — Um Grito na Noite Uma jovem desaparece e a intuição de um policial inexperiente muda o rumo da investigação. Agora, as autoridades correm contra o tempo para encontrá-la a tempo.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S4 E2 — A Culpa Vai te Pegar Dizer que Paul Reagor e Jerry Bailey são grandes amigos é um eufemismo. Após o sumiço misterioso de dois técnicos de futebol americano, as tensões raciais de uma pequena cidade de Oklahoma explodem.
programme.title: Assassinato de uma Sexta à Noite

programme.desc: S3 E13 — Suspeitos Uma jovem desaparece e sua amiga passa a investigar, mas também acaba sumindo. Uma dançarina é assassinada e um cigarro aceso pode ser a evidência que leva ao assassino.
programme.title: Ainda um Mistério

programme.desc: S10 E6 — Entre Amigos A polícia busca respostas sobre quem atirou em três homens após um acidente de carro.
programme.title: Câmera Crime

programme.desc: S5 E8 — Mulheres Primeiro Um casal de idosos desaparece em um domingo à tarde, mas uma pessoa sabe que seus corpos espancados estão no fundo de um poço: o filho do casal, que teve um prazer sádico em matar seus genitores.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S5 E2 — Morte na Estrada Um acidente em uma rodovia da Dakota do Norte mata um passageiro, mas o motorista escapa ileso. Quando a autópsia revela que a vítima foi morta a facadas, os investigadores descobrem que o motorista é um psicopata violento.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S8 E5 — Ligação Mortal Após se encontrar com seu advogado de divórcio e ex-marido, uma mãe de três filhos desaparece. Enquanto amigos e parentes tentam localizá-la, o marido inicia um jogo de gato e rato com os investigadores.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S3 E13 — Mamãe Querida Sonya Bamberg e seu filho Damon são inseparáveis, a ponto de Damon dormir na cama com ela. Quando uma mulher ameaça ficar entre eles, mãe e filho seguem um caminho de loucura e morte.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Irmãos Violentos David e Bryan Freeman foram criados como Testemunhas de Jeová, mas na adolescência, entram para um violento grupo neonazista. Seus pais tentam interferir, mas talvez seja tarde demais.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S15 E6 — Ele me Filmou Tonja Balden não sabe que Andrew Luster, um homem encantador que conheceu em um bar, esconde um segredo sombrio. Ela só descobre que ele filmava seus crimes perversos quando sua história é exposta pela imprensa.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S15 E5 — Assassinato na Casa de Oração Na infância, Joy acredita que sua mãe, Anna Young, é a voz de Deus. Anna castiga brutalmente as crianças que infringem suas regras em uma comunidade religiosa. Anos depois, Joy descobre que sua mãe é uma assassina.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S3 E10 — Luta Inglória Em 2009, a longa e sofrida batalha de uma mulher para superar a dependência química e ajudar outros viciados termina de uma forma inesperada.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Pequenos Cúmplices Em 2001, um homem visita a família e descobre que seu pai desapareceu; um detetive descobre um assassinato que envolve um grupo de crianças; uma mãe se recusa a acreditar que seu filho cometeu um crime brutal.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S4 E9 — O Predador de Pleasant View Suzy Goulart, de 23 anos, vive em um condomínio polêmico em Pleasant View, onde dramas entre amigos e amantes levantam suspeitas quando Suzy é assassinada.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S4 E7 — Alianças Profanas A secretária de igreja Dorothy Finelli, de 59 anos, é encontrada morta. A polícia investiga se ela foi assassinada por um novo namorado ciumento ou por uma pessoa que ela conhecia há anos, de seu próprio círculo familiar.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S2 E10 — Sem Saída Shaunna Dodd conta à polícia que foi mantida como refém sob a mira de uma arma quando seu marido é assassinado durante um suposto assalto. Mais tarde, a descoberta de uma trama de mentiras e traições soluciona o caso.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Sob Controle Depois de dias sem ter notícias de Ramsay, seu filho, Donna Scrivo decide avisar a polícia. Seu pior pesadelo se torna realidade quando um corpo com a cabeça e os membros decepados é encontrado em uma estrada de terra.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Louca Obsessão Celebridades alcançam a posição de ícone graças a seus fãs, mas a admiração extrema pode se transformar em obsessão. O desejo de estar mais perto de seus ídolos leva alguns fãs a se tornarem perseguidores obsessivos.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Jerry! Jerry! Jerry! Por trás das brigas e traições do "The Jerry Springer Show", surgem relatos de abuso, incesto, violência sexual e morte. Produtores e ex-convidados revelam histórias inéditas sobre os bastidores e os danos causados pelo talk show.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Terror no Clube Suncoast O pânico toma conta do Clube Playboy de Suncoast após o assassinato de um fotógrafo que havia registrado o concurso Coelhinha do Ano.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S3 E6 — A Garota na Banheira Vermelha Uma garçonete local é catapultada ao estrelato quando aparece em um ensaio da Playboy; ela absorve a fama e a atenção recém-descoberta até uma surpresa dar errado, terminando em tragédia, e ela se torna vítima em um terrível duplo homicídio.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Cárcere Privado O Copom lida com três casos de cárcere privado em áreas periféricas de São Paulo.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E20 — Terror Embriagado Dois policiais tentam parar um motorista bêbado que acelera na contramão e se veem em uma situação perigosa; uma família percebe um carro ziguezagueando assustadoramente e age para prevenir uma tragédia.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Mamães Ursas Não Brincam em Serviço Um bom samaritano defende um estranho, uma idosa faz o inesperado, um carteiro luta por sua vida, e uma mãe assustadora é flagrada em uma situação precária.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S5 E3 — Controle de Multidão Espectadores testemunham agressão a capitão de barco fluvial em cais e correm para ajudar. Homem foge da polícia usando métodos não convencionais. Funcionária de loja prende um ladrão em sua loja. Segurança defende um clube de strip de homem armado.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: In under two centuries, favorite food brands span continents and cultures, spur innovation and technology, and forever change the food landscape.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: At one point, each and every food brand had to come up with a plan to get people to try them; today, the food and drink marketing industry is worth about $900 billion and growing.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown: Punjab, India
programme.desc: Tony dives into the ever-changing state of Punjab, India. Starting off his journey in Amritsar, Tony is immediately struck by the chaos around him.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: With the slight relaxation of control by the government of Myanmar, Tony is finally able to explore one of the most fabled and beautiful areas of Asia.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode, we leave behind Africa we’ve come to know in the news. Instead, we embrace the wild, untamed land of mystery, adventure, and exoticism; Zanzibar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: For the first time, Tony visits Budapest, 25 years after democracy planted its flag –alongside the Oscar-winning master of light, cinematographer Vilmos Zsigmond, as one of his key guides.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own fingerprint, allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pitiless As the Sun
programme.desc: Andromeda answers a distress call when a cargo ship is attacked.

programme.title: Andromeda: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
programme.desc: The crew looks for a long-lost Commonwealth leader who has gone into hiding.
programme.sub-title: Last Call at the Broken Hammer

programme.title: Andromeda: All Too Human
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a weapon being developed on a planet that distrusts AI.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Andromeda is tasked with escorting medical ships safely through Drago-Kazov space.

programme.title: Andromeda: Home Fires
programme.desc: A planet of Commonwealth survivors led by Dylan's former fiancee is invited to join the new Commonwealth, but when they vote not to join, the Magog are suspected of playing dirty.

programme.title: Andromeda: Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: An agent of the Abyss tries to lure Harper into joining the Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: When they rescue a young prince from an uprising that kills the rest of his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisors.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan and his new Commonwealth fleet take on the Drago-Kazov fleet but find it much larger than expected.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: The Magog eggs in Harper are starting to hatch, so the team builds a Teseract machine.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan takes over a tourist barge in an attempt to escape mercenaries.

programme.title: Andromeda: Be All My Sins Remembered
programme.desc: A body identification goes awry when it turns out Beka's former crewmate isn't dead at all.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dance of the Mayflies
programme.desc: Andromeda rescues dying people from a drift, but they soon turn into zombies being controlled by a hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: In Heaven Now Are Three
programme.desc: The engine of creation is capable of rewriting the universe according to the owner's wishes. Dylan, Beka and Trance must obtain it before someone with dark plans gets it.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Things We Cannot Change

programme.title: Andromeda: Belly of the Beast

programme.title: Andromeda: Immaculate Perception
programme.desc: Genites attack Tyr's wife and colony.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: In 2003, 32-year-old mother of three Sara Neithe vanished from the Hauraki Plains. Neither Sara nor her car have been seen since. Police suspect that Sara has been murdered but without a crime scene, they have been unable to advance the case.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Lie of the Land
programme.desc: Sue Nicholson and Deb Webber investigate one of the most complex and intriguing cases ever featured - did Waikato man Jason Dark commit suicide or was he murdered, as his family believes?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: When The Trail Goes Cold
programme.desc: This episodes involves the disappearance of 62-year-old Kaye Stewart, a woman who went missing while on a short walk on June 13th, 2005.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Looking for Justice
programme.desc: This week, for the first time ever, the prime suspect in a murder enquiry has turned to Sensing Murder for help.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost for Words
programme.desc: Spirited teenager Jayne Furlong dreamed of becoming a child psychologist - instead, she ended up a prostitute. In 1993, 17 year old Jayne vanished from her patch on Auckland's Karangahape Road.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Patient Killer
programme.desc: In 1976, thirteen-year-old schoolgirl Tracey Ann Patient was plucked off Auckland's Great North Road. The following morning, her body was found dumped 16 km away in the Waitakere Ranges, having been strangled with a pantyhose tourniquet.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: In 1957, nine-year-old Peter Boland was on holiday having the time of his life on a remote farm in New Zealand when he simply vanished without a trace. Peter’s older brother Gavin Boland, a self-confessed sceptic, turns to Sensing Murder’s psychics.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Blood Money
programme.desc: Psychics Kelvin Cruickshank (NZ) and Deb Webber (Aus) investigate the unsolved murder of Lower Hutt pensioner 91 year old George Engelbrecht. In 1979, a burglar broke into George's home and beat the old man to death in his bed.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Long Way Home
programme.desc: 25-year-old Te Puke woman Judy Yorke was a devoted single mum who adored her kids. When she missed her daughter’s fourth birthday party, her family knew something was terribly wrong and reported her missing.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken for a Ride
programme.desc: 54 year old Simon Buis was savagely beaten and kicked to death in an Auckland park in 1980 by persons unknown. To this day, his killers have evaded capture.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: In 2006, 19-year-old Blake Stott died in a mysterious car fire. Blake had seemingly pulled into a South Otago lay-by to have a sleep, when his late-model, un-modified car burst into flames.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of 53-year-old, Cynthia Greenwood-Smith, to unravel the lies and discover the grim truth surrounding her disappearance from her Gold Coast home in 2001.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken Out
programme.desc: Was Donovan Reidy deliberately run down and left to die? In 1995, 23-year-old Donovan Reidy was at a party when he got into a fight. A short while later, his bloodied body was found on the side of a major New Zealand highway.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Courage
programme.desc: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Boot Camp
programme.desc: Jim is a bondsman and longtime friend of Dog. Jim's son has just started in the family business. Today, Jim has asked Dog to track down a potentially dangerous fugitive, and take his son along for some training with the best in the world.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Friends and Neighbors
programme.desc: Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission, to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Set-Up
programme.desc: The trail is hot and the stakes is high for Dog and the posse. The "Big Fish" in this case is Marco, an alleged drug dealer with a big bond. But a major key to catching him is Elizabeth, who is also a fugitive from the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Searchers
programme.desc: Dog is still on the search for the elusive fugitive, Marco. Dog has been tracking him across Colorado, from Grand Junction to Denver, and now a hot tip that a long time associate of his is hiding in Pueblo sends the team racing south.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Buddha's Delight
programme.desc: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Three's Company
programme.desc: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district, moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Strip Search
programme.desc: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in. It's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secret Places
programme.desc: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Rider
programme.desc: What looks like a routine pick-up turns into a complicated case of betrayal, deceit, as well as quality nail care as Dog and company track down a fugitive alleged to be an abusive boyfriend with one too many friends in his close knit community.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Midnight Run
programme.desc: This fugitive has a bad reputation and a knack for running from the law. The pursuit has Dog and team traveling through an urban dystopia of suspicion, false leads and mistrust.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Hunt for Santa
programme.desc: Dog decides he needs to help his son Garry believe in Santa Claus again. So now the Dog, with a posse expanded to include his children and grandchildren, sets off on a hunt through the Colorado Rockies for Santa Claus himself!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Call Waiting
programme.desc: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Kid Stuff
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Does It
programme.desc: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive, he always promises them it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back in the Hood
programme.desc: Today, Dog's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills to track his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Road
programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out. He's also giving his nephew Justin a second chance to rejoin the team.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon, Dog knows that someone is being deceived. The only question is, whom?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: True Identity
programme.desc: Dog knows that looks can be deceiving. The fugitive is pretty, petite, and trouble. She stands accused of settling an argument with the help of a box cutter. What Dog does not anticipate is how deceptive this femme fatale can truly be!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: What do you do when you have a fugitive you not only want to find, but believe can be helped back onto the straight and narrow? If you're Mary Ellen you call your good friend Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Match Point
programme.desc: Duty calls and the Chapmans are off on a hunt. The team chases a fugitive who has disappeared into a world of "no known addresses."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Menehune Mischief
programme.desc: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits - Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers - the Menehune!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mister Mom
programme.desc: It's been quite a while since Tim Chapman put down his mace can and bulletproof vest to care for his growing family. When his old friend Dog calls asking for help tracking an elusive felon, Tim jumps into action.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait & Snitch
programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring a client with a checked past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: De-Bug Life
programme.desc: The guys realize it is time for the annual cleaning of the duck blinds when they come across a gator using one as a home. Meanwhile, while the kids are running the church car wash, Si and Willie disagree on the best way to draw in customers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Men vs. Wild
programme.desc: Brotherly competition is taken to a whole new level when Jase and Willie challenge Alan and Jep to a survival race through the woods on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Si is interested in finding a new hobby when he sees Kay cutting coupons.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Return of the Beavers
programme.desc: When Phil discovers more beaver activity on the Robertson land, he recruits Jase, Jep, and Si to get rid of them. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie bring Bella to her first day of karate practice.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Stumped on a way to celebrate Willie's birthday, Korie enlists the guys' help and Jase takes the reigns in planning a trip to the lake where Phil and Kay used to live. Meanwhile, the women realize a raccoon is inside the lake house.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard
programme.desc: When Willie takes a business trip to Scotland to expand his duck call business, he brings the entire family along so they can reconnect with their Scottish roots. Willie organizes a bus tour to trace his family heritage.
programme.sub-title: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Night and Good Duck
programme.desc: A special holiday episode of Duck Dynasty shows when the Robertson family took over the Thanksgiving special of a local TV show "Good Morning Arklamiss." Each family member presents a special holiday segment, with Willie and Jase serving as anchormen.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack in the Saddle
programme.desc: When Willie becomes the temporary owner of a thoroughbred, he and the guys take it to a local track and enter it into a race. Meanwhile, when Kay decides she wants to buy a new birdbath for her yard, she recruits Phil, Martin and Godwin.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: The Robertsons help a long time employee whose Mom has fallen on hard times by buying her a brand new house for Christmas. Jep, Jase, Martin and Godwin race to finish a deck in time for the big reveal, only to get sidetracked by a hammering competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Cannonball Runs
programme.desc: Jase enters an outhouse race to help promote Willie's Duck Diner, but when the Robertsons show up for the race, they face an unexpected rival - Phillip McMillan. Meanwhile, Willie attempts to create the world's greatest bologna sandwich.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Mo Math, Mo Problems
programme.desc: Willie helps Sadie with her homework by enlisting the guys to create a real-life version of a math problem, but when Jase and Willie get sidetracked helping Sadie, they rekindle an old argument of whether Jase can outrun a truck.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Coop! There It Is!
programme.desc: When Jep asks Willie and the guys to help move his old chicken coop into his new house, which is under renovation, Jessica takes issue with its appearance, leading the guys to yet another project - renovating the chicken coop.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Friday Afternoon Lights
programme.desc: When Willie becomes an assistant coach on Lil' Will's struggling football team, his authority is tested when the kids challenge the adults to a scrimmage. Meanwhile, Kay brings Jep and Si to an aquarobics class at a local health club.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Master and Duck Commander

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Armley Mills
programme.desc: Once the centre of industry Armley Mills is now a museum that is said to house the phantoms of many a lost soul. From children who were caught in the machinery to a bad tempered floorwalker who doesn’t like people in his mill.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Carr House
programme.desc: Part of a once splendorous manor and a history that goes back as far as Robin Hood, Carr House is the sight of many a paranormal occurrence.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Hill House_PT1
programme.desc: What was once a private home before becoming a sanctuary for the elderly, the abandoned Hill House is now an eerie shadow of its former glory, that houses empty rooms, strange noises and a plethora of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Hill House_PT2
programme.desc: Part one saw the team seemingly getting stalked by something, and in this part it shows its hand.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Village Church Farm
programme.desc: A museum like no other, this small collection of antiquated buildings is said to be the home of several spirits. The team get more than they bargained for as objects move; strange noises are caught on camera and the best EVP response to date.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Old Nick Theatre
programme.desc: Once a prison and a police station and now a theatre the Old Nick is famous for its unexplained occurrences. Fred decides to summon up some extra help while objects move and something wants to make itself known.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Black Country Living Museum
programme.desc: The team have a whole village to investigate with results that amazed the all. With a playful spirit communicating through the Ouija board and the EVP machine at the same time the team seem to have their first two-way conversation with the dead.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Lyceum Theatre
programme.desc: The Lyceum Theatre in Crewe is known for its paranormal activity and in this episode the team take the fight right to phantoms that lurk in its darkness with some frightening consequences.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Whittingdon Castle
programme.desc: The ghost of a drowned soldier awaits Yvette and her team of paranormal experts as they tackle the hauntings that plague this once magnificent castle.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Halsham House
programme.desc: Nestled into the British countryside is Halsham house where a poltergeist hides in wait for the team with frightening effect. With bones found in the attic have the team pushed it too far.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Mansion House
programme.desc: Yvette takes her fearless team to a onetime house, onetime museum and now a care home to investigate the strange goings on reported by staff and guests alike. It doesn’t take long for Yvette to regret her decision to go it alone in the cold dark cellar.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Banker and The Bum
programme.desc: A greedy banker and a good-hearted bum switch places. The bum dies, but the banker is now infused with love and generosity.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Brightest Star
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Investment In Caring
programme.desc: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Right Thing
programme.desc: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 1
programme.desc: Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 1
programme.desc: Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Bless the Boys in Blue
programme.desc: Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Cindy
programme.desc: An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
programme.desc: Mark has been tricked into selling his soul in order to save a little girl's life. But the Devil has another agenda: acquiring Jonathan's soul.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Factory workers ignore ground-water contamination, even though it is making their children sick. As a result, Jonathan takes drastic measures to force them to face the facts.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Popcorn, Peanuts and Crackerjacks
programme.desc: A minor-league baseball team never wins, so Jonathan and Mark set out to help them. They also come to the aid of an elderly vendor who has been kicked out of the stadium.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Smile in the Third Row
programme.desc: The lead actor in a Broadway play claims that God is attending the show's performances, sitting in a third-row orchestra seat.
programme.sub-title: The Smile in the Third Row

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Secret
programme.desc: The teenage daughter of Mark's friend tries to find her biological mother. It may tear the family apart.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance. He defends the young artist with a facial deformity who has been accused of assaulting a blind girl.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Good Doctor
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark go to work at a football team. They learn that one of the players has been getting drugs from the team doctor.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's the grand reopening of Mara and a British wildlife charity is using the event to release a vulture back into the wild. Fatani, the new, young and ambitious manager of Mara has hired Danny as the vet to oversee the release.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is looking after a sick and orphaned baby elephant called Togo. However, despite Evan and Du Plessis' constant vigil, Togo is dying from a broken heart. Evan is distraught and Du Plessis promises they will look after her together.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Everyone's excited at the prospect of Leopard's Den's new arrival. Bash, Danny's old tutor and Rosie's Godfather, is coming from England to help Danny grow his veterinary practice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Trevanions are delighted when Fatani asks Danny to take an aggressive hippo off his hands. As they prepare for its arrival Sarah gets a bit of a shock when her mother Caroline beats the hippo to the post.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Business is looking up at Leopard's Den but Sarah is feeling agitated. Caroline thinks it because Simon, her ex husband and Evan and Olivia's Dad, is arriving from England to get married. But Sarah has other things on her mind.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Du Plessis is in a foul mood. It's his 60th birthday and he has no intentions of celebrating it. But the Trevanions have other ideas and Caroline is organising a surprise party.

programme.desc: A customer dies from poisoned wine dining at a café, and the waiter falls under suspicion because he was a former chemist.

programme.desc: A man demands to be arrested for murdering his wealthy wife whose death is attributed to natural causes. A valuable coin collection holds the answers.

programme.desc: Behind the "silver curtain" spray from a fountain, a man is found dead with a knife in his back. Colonel March is called in to investigate.

programme.desc: A shady businessman collapses on an oceanside jetty, the apparent victim of a heart attack, but March discovers blood and a needle near the body.

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Case of the Lively Ghost

programme.sub-title: The Case of the Lively Ghost

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Death in the Dressing Room
programme.desc: Murder and blackmail culminate when a call for help during a Javenese dance is the clue that Colonel March needs to prove a faulty alibi.

programme.sub-title: My Mother Murdered By Her Golden Boy Son

programme.sub-title: He Trapped Our Sons In The Attic, Then Set Fire To The House
